name: Result seen through the product
description: Tie an impressive output directly to the product that creates it. Builds an editable 12-second vertical ad from your images, logo and copy. AI can suggest options from a website to fill the fields with its copy and images. No generated video.
tagline: A real output can be aligned inside the product or application that made it.

props.subtitle: A 5-scene vertical ad, 12 seconds long. You supply images and short lines of copy. The app builds an editable cut, not a generated video.

props.text: Lays out every frame and finishes the cut. Pick one that reads images. Saved for next time.
Optional. Paints backgrounds and decoration for the layout. Saved for next time.

props.label: How do you want to start?

options.title: Fill from a website
options.description: Paste a product page. AI suggests the copy and images.

props.label: Website
props.hint: The agent reads the page with the finishing model and suggests three filled versions, with real images from the site. Pick one, then check each step.

props.text: No site at hand? Try this one.

props.label: Agent
props.placeholder: The agent's reading and image searches appear here.

props.subtitle: The impressive output fills the screen first.

props.text: The best thing your product made, at full quality.

props.subtitle: Your product window appears around the result and shows how it was made.

props.text: A screenshot of your app window, ideally with an empty content area.

props.label: Benefit
props.placeholder: Pro results without the learning curve

props.subtitle: Result, product and the next step stay on screen.

props.label: Layout agent
props.placeholder: The agent's layout edits and frame reviews appear here.

props.title: The layout needs a look
props.text: Edit the cut or plan again. You can still approve it.

value.title: Result seen through the product
value.objective: Tie an impressive output directly to the product that creates it.
value.direction: The result and the product window align spatially; a mask explains the relationship.
beats: 0–2 s: The impressive output fills the scene. Shows Brand color, Result image, Result line.
2–4.5 s: Product/window frame appears over the aligned result. Shows Brand color, Result image, Product frame, Product line.
4.5–7.5 s: Window content shows a relevant change or detail. Shows Brand color, Result image, Product frame, Feature line.
7.5–9.5 s: Pull back to an intelligible product-plus-result composition. Shows Brand color, Result image, Product frame, Benefit.
9.5–12 s: Result, product and next step remain visible. Shows Brand color, Result image, Product frame, Logo, Call to action.

images.label: Result image
images.guidance: A real photo or screenshot that matches the beats that show it. Shown in: The impressive output fills the scene. | Product/window frame appears over the aligned result. | Window content shows a relevant change or detail. | Pull back to an intelligible product-plus-result composition. | Result, product and next step remain visible.

images.label: Product frame
images.guidance: A shot of the product alone, ideally on a plain or transparent background, so it reads as a cutout. Shown in: Product/window frame appears over the aligned result. | Window content shows a relevant change or detail. | Pull back to an intelligible product-plus-result composition. | Result, product and next step remain visible.

images.label: Logo
images.guidance: The brand's own logo file, such as the site header logo or its icon. Shown in: Result, product and next step remain visible.
